terms.comment: Classically any drinking cup (in Cato and Ovid also a cooking pot); in the Church the cup of the Eucharist, in East and West alike.

phrases.latin: Similiter et calicem, postquam coenāvit, dīcēns: Hic calix novum testāmentum est in meō sanguine
phrases.english: In the same way he took the cup after supper, saying: This cup is the new covenant in my blood

phrases.latin: Calicem salūtāris accipiam, et nōmen Dominī invocābō.
phrases.english: I will take the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord.

sources: Lewis & Short: calix
